journey.title: Shopping and changes
journey.purpose: Review the week's groceries, shop in Shop mode, absorb a plan change mid-trip, and confirm purchases — without a checkmark ever becoming a purchase or losing picked-up items.

steps.intent: Open the week's groceries from Review groceries.
Review pantry checks and mark items the kitchen already has.
Switch to Shop mode and pick items up with large checkboxes.
Check a row and undo a mistaken check without losing focus.
Review a plan change that keeps picked-up and manual items.
Confirm what was actually bought, including a partial purchase.

claims.statement: Only Confirm purchases records purchases and stock, exactly once.
Checks made offline replay idempotently on reconnect and conflicts are shown.
